newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime up nearly three pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime up nearly three pct in late trade.

text.p: Leading Philippine shopping mall developer SM Prime Holdings Inc rose by centavos, or 2.98 percent, to 6.90 pesos in late trade on Thursday on bargain-hunting and expectations of higher earnings, traders said.
"Whenever the market goes up, SM Prime usually rides the wave. It is one of the favourites of foreign funds," said Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping & Associates.
The stock market's main index was up by 13.31 points to 2,552.28 points in late trade.
"It could be because SM Prime will soon open two malls and one mall translates to about a 20 percent increase in its income for the year," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.

SM Prime earlier said it was opening two new malls each year over the next five years. By July, the firm will open one mall in Manila's Quezon district and another in Cavite province, south of the capital.
SM Prime was the second most actively traded issue in late trade with 64.54 million pesos in turnover.
